label: Whatever is IMMENSE_2 and present to all whenever they are is IMMENSE_1
paraphrase: Open narrowed sense bridge, analyst formulation, unattributed. Whatever is IMMENSE_2 and, in every history of the model, present by giving being to every other thing whenever it is, is IMMENSE_1 (the primitive Primitives.Immense: measured or contained by no place and present to everything that is). After q.8 a.1-3. It carries what the immensity sense bridge 8bf775e9 carries once its presence step is typed: place, containment and measure; presence by power and by knowledge (the other modes of q.8 a.3); immediacy; and the passage from typed presence to the primitive. It no longer carries the contact principle or sustaining causation, which are separate open premises of the route that derives 8bf775e9 from it. Entailed by 8bf775e9 (registered strength order; its antecedent is stronger). Strictness is not checked: with no being other than g, presence to all holds trivially and the two bridges coincide.
